\[I am Hastur, send me the money\]

Listen to my voice, mortal.

I am Hastur, the King in Yellow.

I am trapped in a black star and need the aid of my followers.

When the Aldebaran rise high in the heavens, chant my name, take 100000 Silver Cores to the pawn shop across from Mythag University.

Release me from my seal.

Tomorrow, when I descend, I shall appoint you as the leader of the Old Ones, to lead their minions, and grant you eternal life!

\-- Sender from the unknown abyss.

/////

\[Beware Scammers\]

Vile, disgusting.

There is no such thing as King in Yellow.

And Hastur too.

Don't be fooled by lies.

I shall bestow upon you a gift.

Some deceive, others grant gifts.

It goes without saying which is noble and which is ignoble.

Believe me.

\--Tulu.

I always interpreted the theme being less about "everything must die" and more of "fighting to be remembered even after death", especially with the chinese name translating to "The night before forgetting"
so in a way, awakeners being pulled back from the dead rather than being forgotten and dissoluted kiiiiinda plays with the theme?

the theme overall is resist the entropy, even if they're dissoluted, some left Silver behind (which has dissolution-resist property), then the Awakeners awakening, being forgotten by the world now coming back as a sort of instruments (also revealed in some background stories like ||hooman Doll racing with the time while being dissoluted or so||)
